name: FreshRSS
description: A feed aggregator that keeps up with hundreds of feeds on a small server. The first visit runs its setup; SQLite is the right choice there for one person.

access.note: The first visit runs FreshRSS's install wizard, which creates the only account on this instance. Whoever opens the address first becomes its owner, so open it yourself as soon as the deployment is ready.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.label: Timezone
inputs.description: Feed refresh times and the reader's clock.

inputs.name: refresh
inputs.label: Refresh minutes
inputs.description: The minutes of each hour feeds are fetched, in cron syntax.

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Feeds, articles and the SQLite database

update.notes: FreshRSS updates its database schema on start.
